caso.texto:
The offer supports one site, up to five users and a defined region. A fictional 30-row list contains ten initially fitting accounts, six requiring multiple sites, four outside the region, five with essential unknowns, three no-contact records and two confirmed duplicates.

A Pune supplier serves a defined area and requires accounts to verify invoice prerequisites later in qualification. Similar trading names do not establish identity; do not request personal identity numbers to fix a basic account duplicate.

projeto.instrucoes: Classify all 30 rows, select ten for initial investigation with reasons, record five gaps and explain duplicate consolidation without losing restrictions.
projeto.gabarito: Ten have initial fit, not confirmed purchase. Six and four fall outside scope; five need verification; three remain suppressed. Duplicates are not new accounts and must preserve history. Scores cannot override refusal or mandatory mismatch.

avaliacao_basica.observacao: Não substitui banco profissional de 40 questões / Does not replace a 40-question professional bank

simulacao.instrucao_ator: Play the fictional buyer. Reveal supplied facts when asked; say you need to verify unknowns. Do not teach or score during dialogue. After three turns raise a timing or scope concern; in a second round request closure.
simulacao.instrucao_avaliador: Use only the transcript and rubric. Cite evidence, identify gaps and request human review for uncertain scores. Do not issue certificates or approve contracts.
